ECHO.direction: lower-pitched, measured, precise, restrained synthetic delivery

ZYRA.direction: expressive, playful, curious, slightly otherworldly; lifted resonant timbre with a subtle layered harmonic shimmer and short spatial reflections; conversational rather than assistant-like
ZYRA.engine_voice: eSpeak en-us+f4 with original audio post-processing
ZYRA.sound_design: subtle harmonic layer, chorus and short echo; intelligibility preserved

generation_method: Offline eSpeak synthesis with original post-processing. ZYRA has a stylized alien sound design; these are synthetic performances, not human recordings or voice imitations.
disclosure: Synthetic character voices generated offline. ZYRA audio has additional original alien timbre processing. No actor or copyrighted character voice is cloned.
license_reference: eSpeak project licensing and attribution should be reviewed by the team before redistribution: https://github.com/espeak-ng/espeak-ng
playback_priority: Bundled character MP3 recordings are played first. Browser speech synthesis is only a fallback for dialogue without a bundled clip.
playback_behavior: ECHO and ZYRA opening dialogue plays automatically in sequence; manual character Play/Replay buttons are removed.

earth_intro_music.behavior: Starts automatically on Start Mission at audible volume; if the browser blocks playback, an ENABLE SOUND control appears. Stops when the cinematic ends or is skipped.

voice_quality_note: Current dialogue assets remain synthetic eSpeak performances. A genuinely natural, non-robotic voice requires new licensed human performances or a suitable neural TTS provider; pitch adjustment alone cannot achieve this.
